# How Xero Developer changes affect your practice

## Overview

- How changes to the way Xero charges developers could affect your practice.
- How our updated data-use policies better protect yours and your clients’ data.

About the changes to Xero Developer
Xero is changing the pricing model and policies that apply to third-party app developers who integrate with Xero. These changes are designed to make pricing more equitable and support the responsible use of yours and your clients’ data.

### How the new pricing model works

From 2 March 2026, Xero Developer is changing from a revenue-share model to a tiered usage-based pricing model. Pricing will largely be based on the number of Xero customers connected to an app and the amount of data the app extracts from Xero.

To support innovation in our app ecosystem, the entry-level Starter tier will remain free. This keeps barriers to entry low so developers and startups can continue to build new solutions for practices.

Find out more about the new pricing model on [Xero Developer](https://developer.xero.com/pricing).

### Updates to Xero Developer policies

To support the responsible use of your practice’s and your clients’ data, we’ve updated our developer policies to limit how data obtained via Xero’s APIs can be used.

These policies came into effect for new apps from 4 December 2025 and will come into effect for existing apps from 2 March 2026.

With these updated policies, Xero developers can no longer:

- Use data obtained through Xero’s APIs to train AI models
- Use bots or browser extensions to undermine Xero’s security controls or simulate user actions
Find out more about how these policy changes affect data use on [Xero Developer](https://developer.xero.com/pricing#xero-developer-platform-terms-and-conditions-including-the-associated-commercial-terms).

What these changes mean for your practice
Find out how your apps, tools and data might be affected by these changes.

### What’s excluded from the new pricing model?

In addition to the custom integrations built specifically for your practice or single client use, many tools for managing practices and clients are excluded from the new pricing model. These include:

- Data conversion apps
- Financial services apps including bank feeds, credit integrations and third-party payment partnerships

### Will this affect the price of apps?

Our new pricing model is based on a fair value exchange for data, where developers pay for the data and connections they use.

For the majority of developers, their pricing will remain the same or decrease. We’re working with developers with high-consumption apps to optimise their data usage.

### How will Journals and practice management in Xero Partner Hub access be affected?

There are two distinct ways apps can interact with journals in Xero:

- **Manual Journals endpoint (data in):** This endpoint is used to make adjustments in Xero. Most apps use this endpoint to push data into Xero, and this remains free.
- **Journals endpoint (data out):** This endpoint is used to extract the general ledger from Xero in bulk. This endpoint requires a security assessment and use-case review.
To better protect customer data, developers must complete a security assessment to access the practice management in Xero Partner Hub (previously Xero Practice Manager) API and the Journals endpoint for bulk extraction of data out of Xero. Accountants and bookkeepers can still access the Journals endpoint and the practice management API for free by completing the security assessment.

Learn more about the difference between the Journals and Manual Journals endpoints in our new pricing model in our [Xero Developer Blog](https://devblog.xero.com/navigating-the-shift-understanding-journals-vs-manual-journals-in-the-new-xero-app-tiers-dd8cc09a8418). Find out more about the security assessment on [Xero Developer](https://developer.xero.com/faq/xero-ecosystem-security-requirements-update).

### Use of bots and browser extensions

When selecting or building tools for your practice and clients, we recommend always using our official API connections and certified integrations from the Xero App Store to maintain the quality and security of your data.

We’ll be working to improve our APIs and features so you can better automate your workflows, while keeping your data secure.

## What's next?

If you have further questions or need support around these changes, contact the Xero Developer team at [api@xero.com](mailto:api@xero.com).
